Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 7
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the gathered dates and applied inconsistent criteria. Despite explicitly noting that Niyoti had an actual India release on 10 June 2016 and Angali Pangali released on 17 June 2016, the Planner concluded Angali Pangali came out earlier—an internal logical contradiction. Additionally, the Planner improperly prioritized an "official worldwide release" (24 June) over the earliest actual public release when the question asked which film “came out earlier.” This synthesis error directly led to the wrong final answer.
